May the Lord scatter all deceitful lips,

Because of the misery of the destitute

I will act faithfully toward him.
The eloquence of the Lord is pure eloquence,
silver tested by fire, purged from the earth,
et custodies nos a generatione hac in æternum.
and you will guard us from this generation into eternity.
secundum altitudinem tuam multiplicasti filios hominum.
